items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: So she called me to be her music director. And it was right when neo-soul was happening. So when she went solo she was going to go neo-soul. You know. So we talked for a good three months getting together, I had the band together and we were about to rock it.

ctx.x: Can you see yourself doing something with Beyoncé?

Yeah. I do. I don’t know when. It’s funny, when Beyoncé first went solo I had just got out of college. I think it was 2000, 2001. And they were about to get her solo career happening. So she called me to be her music director. And it was right when neo-soul was happening. So when she went solo she was going to go neo-soul. You know. So we talked for a good three months getting together, I had the band together and we were about to rock it. And then she was like, “okay they changed my whole thing up. It’s not

happening anymore.” And then she went, that’s when she went pop, totally pop. So they immediately switched that up. But I totally see at some point us doing something at some point. I don’t know when but, one day.
